GeneDef.label: lighteyes heritage
GeneDef.description: Born with the light-colored eyes that mark the ruling caste across Vorin nations. Lighteyes are expected to lead, to fight, and to carry the weight of their station.

GeneDef.label: highborn bearing
GeneDef.description: Carries the practiced poise and authority of the lighteyed caste. Commands attention in conversation and negotiation alike.

GeneDef.label: caste education
GeneDef.description: Raised with access to tutors, texts, and military training. Learns faster than those denied such privilege.
